features.name: Venomous Strike
features.text: Make an attack against any number of targets within Very Close range. On a success, a target is temporarily _Poisoned_. A _Poisoned_ creature takes **1d10** direct physical damage each time they act.

features.name: Warning Hiss
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to force any number of targets within Melee range to move back to Very Close range.
